scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" run uvicorn rfq_api.main:app --app-dir src --reload
scripts.generate:types: cd apps/api && "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" run python -m rfq_api.tools.export_openapi ../openapi.json && cd ../.. && corepack pnpm exec openapi-typescript apps/openapi.json -o apps/web/src/lib/api/generated.ts
